faqs.question: How do I make sarcasm land clearly with 💨🍂?
faqs.answer: Pair 💨🍂 with a clear lead-up that sets the joke. Sarcasm-coded emojis work best when the surrounding message makes the irony obvious.

faqs.question: Is 💨🍂 Gen Z slang?
faqs.answer: 💨🍂 is multigenerational but it sits heaviest with Gen Z and younger millennials. Older senders sometimes use it accidentally and mean it literally.

faqs.question: Does 💨🍂 have a hidden meaning?
faqs.answer: 💨🍂 does not have a hidden meaning. The sarcasm-coded cue is the surface read; deeper context comes from the message it sits next to.

faqs.question: Is 💨🍂 mean?
faqs.answer: 💨🍂 is not mean. The sarcasm-coded cue is a soft register; if you read it as mean, the sender probably layered extra text around the combo.
